newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean military to carry out scheduled drill.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean military to carry out scheduled drill.

text.p: The South Korean military said it would go ahead with a previously scheduled joint exercise involving the army, navy, and air force on Tuesday.

The exercise's schedule had been finalized before an attempted defection of a top North Korean official last week at South Korea's embassy compound in Beijing, an official from the Joint Command Staff said.

The Joint Command, in a statement, said the exercise would take place between 2.00 p.m. and 4.00 p.m. (0500-0700 GMT), weather permitting. It will involve two jets flying over Seoul and surrounding areas posing as enemy aircraft.
"If weather conditions are bad we will push the exercise back one day, but at the moment it is scheduled for today," said the official, who asked not to be named.

The South Korean army's Chungui Unit also started a routine six-day "massive tactical training" drill on Monday, covering the west coast, Inchon, and southwestern Kyunggi province, the army said in a statement.
